newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to make radio address on summit.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to make radio address on summit.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin will deliver a radio address on Wednesday dealing with Russian foreign policy and the results of his summit with U.S. President Bill Clinton, the Kremlin press service said.
It gave no details. The broadcast is expected to be start at 1400 GMT.
The communist opposition charges that Yeltsin betrayed Russia's interests by compromising over NATO's plans to expand eastwards during his meeting with Clinton last week in Helsinki.

Yeltsin dropped a previous demand that any deal Moscow concludes with NATO outlining ties with the Western defence alliance should be legally binding, saying instead that it should be politically binding only.
